authenticated_release_gate.boundary: Authenticated readiness proves measured-byte linkage, configured producer authorization, and lifecycle-policy conformance only; it does not prove source correctness, verifier soundness, build correctness, semantic equivalence, runtime authority, or universal release fitness

determinism_replay.reason: workspace replay may copy fixtures and is an explicit operator/CI preflight

function_address.boundary: Cairn consumed Valence, Mantle, and Kamacite function-address evidence for lifecycle/release policy conformance only; it did not prove Rust semantic correctness, compiler correctness, whole-program safety, verifier soundness, or release eligibility
function_address.name: function_address_evidence

repository_gate_summary.note: The bundle records the maintained release gate policy; operators still run heavyweight repository gates outside this local receipt command. The maintained traceability gate is Cairn-owned and does not require the external Tracey binary.

stack_provenance.boundary: Cairn consumed Valence and Mantle stack provenance receipts for lifecycle/release policy conformance only; it did not prove source-code correctness, Valence verifier soundness, Mantle build correctness, or Trellis/Octet proof validity
stack_provenance.name: stack_provenance

result.verification_role_boundary: verification_role_summary counts only property artifacts as verified; recorded_only and boundary artifacts prove nothing

workspace_contract_matrix.boundary: workspace contract matrix validation proves declared edge health only; it does not prove provider correctness, does not prove consumer behavioral correctness, does not prove verifier soundness, or does not prove release eligibility
